name: The player's timeline marks (Bookmarks 1.1.6): the playing video's bookmarks on the position slider, beside jellyfin-web's chapter marks. As admin on Chaptered Movie (five chapters, a minute long), with a point at 0:10, the range 0:20-0:25 and an untitled point at 0:45: three amber ticks and a band, each within 1 px of where the slider puts its time and centred on the track, with the titles and times as tooltips; a click on a tick plays from there; Shift+B's new bookmark is marked at once; the same at phone width (390x844, touch). The movie's bookmarks are reset first and removed at the end.

steps.name: find Chaptered Movie, its runtime and chapters
steps.eval: (async () => { const m = (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Chaptered Movie', Limit: 1, Fields: 'RunTimeTicks,Chapters' })).Items[0]; return { id: m.Id, runtime: m.RunTimeTicks, chapters: m.Chapters.length }; })()

steps.name: five chapters, a minute long
steps.message: Chaptered Movie isn't the sandbox's five-chapter minute

steps.name: reset the movie's bookmarks to 'Timeline P' (a point at 0:10), 'Timeline R' (the range 0:20-0:25) and an untitled point at 0:45
steps.script: const itemId = __vars.movie.id; const url = (p, q) => ApiClient.getUrl(p, q); for (const b of await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId }))) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: url('Bookmarks/' + b.Id, { deleteClip: 'true' }) }); } for (const body of [{ ItemId: itemId, StartTicks: 100000000, Name: 'Timeline P' }, { ItemId: itemId, StartTicks: 200000000, EndTicks: 250000000, Name: 'Timeline R' }, { ItemId: itemId, StartTicks: 450000000 }]) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: url('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify(body), contentType: 'application/json' }); } return (await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId }))).map(b => (b.Name || '-') + ' ' + b.StartTicks + (b.EndTicks ? '-' + b.EndTicks : ''));

steps.name: their starts by id
steps.eval: (async () => { const list = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movie.id })); return Object.fromEntries(list.map(b => [b.Id, b.StartTicks])); })()

steps.name: the range's end by id
steps.eval: (async () => { const list = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movie.id })); return Object.fromEntries(list.filter(b => b.EndTicks).map(b => [b.Id, b.EndTicks])); })()

steps.name: measure the marks against the track (desktop)
steps.eval: (() => { const page = [...document.querySelectorAll('[id=videoOsdPage]')].find(p => !p.classList.contains('hide')); const input = page.querySelector('.osdPositionSlider'); const c = input.parentNode; const track = c.querySelector('.mdl-slider-background-flex').getBoundingClientRect(); const runtime = __vars.movie.runtime; const at = (ticks) => track.left + track.width * ticks / runtime; const mid = (b) => b.top + b.height / 2; const layer = c.querySelector(':scope > .jfbm-timeline'); const ticks = [...layer.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-timeline-mark')].map(t => { const b = t.getBoundingClientRect(); return { title: t.title, dx: Math.round((b.left + b.width / 2 - at(__vars.starts[t.getAttribute('data-id')])) * 10) / 10, dy: Math.round((mid(b) - mid(track)) * 10) / 10 }; }); const bands = [...layer.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-timeline-range')].map(r => { const b = r.getBoundingClientRect(); const id = r.getAttribute('data-id'); return { dLeft: Math.round((b.left - at(__vars.starts[id])) * 10) / 10, dRight: Math.round((b.right - at(__vars.ends[id])) * 10) / 10, dy: Math.round((mid(b) - mid(track)) * 10) / 10 }; }); const first = layer.querySelector('.jfbm-timeline-mark').getBoundingClientRect(); return { width: Math.round(track.width), layerLast: c.lastElementChild === layer, ariaHidden: layer.getAttribute('aria-hidden'), chapters: c.querySelectorAll('.sliderMarkerContainer > .sliderMarker').length, ticks, bands, onTick: document.elementFromPoint(first.left + first.width / 2, mid(first)).className, offTicks: document.elementFromPoint(at(runtime * 0.6), mid(track)).className }; })()

steps.name: the controls shown again until the 0:45 tick has a size (a hide jellyfin-web started before the pause ends with .hide when its slide-down animation finishes, which can be after the controls were shown above)
steps.waitFor: (() => { document.querySelectorAll('.videoOsdBottom').forEach(o => o.classList.remove('hide', 'videoOsdBottom-hidden')); const t = document.querySelector('#videoOsdPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-timeline .jfbm-timeline-mark:last-child'); if (!t) return false; const r = t.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0; })()
